chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Donald Kirkpatrick, Redman's pianist and arranger
summary: Kirkpatrick came to Redman from Chick Webb, wrote beautiful arrangements, loved to eat, and married Johnny Hodges's sister.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well, we've gone through a lot of musicians --
Now, we -- Oh, yeah, but we --
-- but there was another good pianist that was with Don Redman, was Donald Kirkpatrick.
A great pianist and a great arranger. You know, he was with Chick Webb way back.

He was with Chick Webb, one of the first pianists with Chick Webb. And Don got him from Chick, in fact. He made a lot of good arrangements for Don, a lot of beautiful arrangements. He was a quiet guy, and he could eat, too, Kirk could.
He was married to Johnny Hodges' sister.
Who's the other piano player that Pearl Bailey had for so many years with her that died just recently? He was a friend of Don Redman's.
I know, and he was a friend of Kirkpatrick. He and Kirkpatrick used to have a piano duo down in the Village.
Yeah. We'll recall his name in a few minutes because --
I know, and a very good accompanist.
